applied_settings: ORIGINAL TUNE. PROBED IMMEDIATELY BEFORE STARTING, not assumed: core clock at a locked 3090 target read 2948.1 MHz mean / 2955 max, which is the original-tune signature (split reads ~2977, stock ~2610); memory clock under load read 16301 MHz, confirming the +2500 offset (stock is 13801). Curve shape per section 5.7: core V/F curve pinned flat at ~3010 MHz from ~925 mV upward, raised above stock below that. Power limit 200W. Instant Replay OFF, encoder and decoder 0% at preflight. Second configuration tested under protocol v1.0.0; the split curve passed the same 30-minute test earlier this session (20260823-183256), so these two are directly comparable - same protocol version, same card, same evening, roughly 40 minutes apart.
duty_cycle_note: Load is not perfectly continuous. Each benchmark iteration is a separate Python process, so roughly 2 s of torch import and CUDA context creation sits between iterations. At these iteration counts that is about 3% of wall time, against 25% at the tool defaults. Read loaded_fraction in the logger's session JSON for the measured figure.
note: A clean run is not proof of stability. Undervolt failures routinely take hours to appear, and the degradation threshold is uncalibrated.
